subject: Future Tech
title: Starship: The Mega Rocket
description: A micro-lesson that makes Starship: The Mega Rocket usable.

hook.text: SpaceX's Starship is the largest and most powerful rocket ever built. It stands 120 meters tall and is fully reusable.

buildup.text: Its 33 Raptor engines produce 74 meganewtons of thrust, nearly double the Saturn V that sent astronauts to the Moon.

discovery.text: Starship can carry 150 tons to low Earth orbit. That capacity could deliver entire habitat modules in a single flight.

twist.text: Catching the booster with mechanical arms instead of landing legs saves weight and speeds up turnaround time.

climax.text: NASA chose Starship as the lunar lander for Artemis. Mars transport is the next goal on the company's roadmap.

punchline.text: Starship is a freight train to the solar system.

quiz.question: How many Raptor engines does Starship's first stage use?
